method: One completed first action per site, not a goto. Escalation ladder headless-masked -> headless-stock -> headed, stopping at the first rung where an action completed; a site is blocked only if every rung refused it. Generic selectors only, query "blue" typed unchanged at every site. Locale en-US, timezone America/New_York, no proxying. Masking is the HeadlessChrome token and nothing else.
